description.value:
You loose a crackling bolt of Force lightning at a target within range, making a ranged force attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 lightning damage, and any flammable object in the area not worn or carried ignites.

The damage increases to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th level, and 4d10 at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
